personality: 7 Dark-First Utility DARK with Custom Premium Brand Colors
personality_one_liner: A premium, dark-themed, futuristic educational 'express train' that feels like an exclusive boarding pass to the AI-driven jobs of tomorrow.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for premium feel. Utilize md (12) for inner padding and lg (16) to xl (24) for block separation.

do's: Apply frosted glass (expo-blur) over #10162c at 80% opacity for sticky headers, nav bars, and floating action buttons.
Use subtle blur backdrops behind premium feature cards to enhance the 'futuristic train' theme.
dont's: Do not blur standard list rows or form inputs. Maintain high contrast readability for dense data screens.

screens.name: Home (Discover & Board)
screens.purpose: Front door to the AI train, showcasing the primary CTA to board and a track picker.

states.loading: Centered train wheel loading animation or green spinner.
states.error: Failed to load tracks. Show retry.

screens.layout: 2-row Top App Header (Brand row + Nav row with 'Learn-AI / Build-AI' dropdowns and 'Sign In' pill). Below header: Hero Banner (rounded, bordered dark-green gradient panel featuring the futuristic train image with text overlay 'LEAD WITH AI. Board the AI Train'). Below hero: Track Picker (grid or horizontal scroll of 7 learning tracks). Use radio-style picker rows for track selection, keeping it highly operational.

screens.name: Track Detail & Learn
screens.purpose: Display the learning track stations timeline and house the AI-grading interactions.
screens.layout: Vertical timeline of 'Stations'. Sticky track title header. Provide a 'Sample Course' module containing a video thumbnail and a quiz CTA. During quiz submission, show the AI-grading loading state: spinning ring with rotating status messages. Below, show success (badge) or failure.

screens.name: Certify (Boarding Pass)
screens.purpose: The ultimate ticket representing enrollment and achievement.
screens.layout: Display a large 'Boarding Pass / Ticket' card centered. Design specs: dark-green gradient header strip, light cream panel (surfaceInverse #f4f1e8), dashed perforation with punch holes, QR code block, and a green footer bar (brandPrimary). Use a swipeable card carousel if multiple tickets exist. Avoid generic paper look; make it digital-premium.

screens.name: Build (AI Lab)
screens.layout: Use a grid of cards detailing the 6 stages. Incorporate dark/neon tech lab imagery subtly in card backgrounds with linear-gradient scrims (transparent to #10162c at bottom). Include a 'Commercialize' sticky bottom CTA offering a 75/25 revenue share graphic (pie chart or progress bar visual).

screens.name: Store & Checkout
screens.purpose: Purchase exploratory tickets, event passes, and apparel.
screens.layout: Grid layout for apparel, tile layout for tickets. Concert/event tickets use the golden texture background with #0a0e1f text overlay. Bottom fixed cart bar. Checkout screen: standard single-column form with radio button payment selection (include a disabled PayPal placeholder) and 'Order Confirmed' receipt sheet.

screens.name: Sign In
screens.purpose: Rich 9-role sign-in and user authentication form.
screens.layout: Full-height dark container. Top shows founder portrait inside a circular or rounded avatar, or an atmospheric campus shot. Then, a rich form with 9-role picker (small muted chips), file-upload placeholder (for resumes), and a primary green pill submit button.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly enforce the color tokens defined in the JSON. The design represents an exclusive, dark, futuristic aesthetic. Background is #0a0e1f, main panels are #10162c, and the primary brand accent is #34e08a (green).
Use Space Grotesk for all headings (H1, H2, card titles) and Inter for body text. Weight must not exceed 500.
Implement the custom 'Boarding Pass/Ticket' strictly as defined: dark-green header, cream panel (#f4f1e8 text must be inverted to #0a0e1f for contrast), dashed perforations, and a green footer.
The Home Screen MUST include a 2-row Top App Header featuring a Brand row and Nav row with specific dropdowns (Learn-AI, Build-AI, etc.) and a 'Sign In' pill.
For all photographic backgrounds (Hero Train, AI Lab, Campus), you must use the provided URLs with a linear-gradient scrim (top to bottom fade to #10162c) to guarantee text readability.
Maintain the train metaphor throughout interactions - loading states should feel operational (e.g., AI-grading spinner with rotating messages).
